title: Lamp A Resistance
description: Essential: Correctly calculates lamp A's resistance using P=U²/R, obtaining 10 Ω.

title: Internal Resistance Calculation
description: Essential: Correctly solves for the internal resistance (2 Ω) using the closed-circuit equation at point E.

title: Lamp B Rated Power
description: Essential: Correctly solves for lamp B's rated power (1.8 W) using the circuit conditions at point F.

title: Circuit Analysis at Point E
description: Important: Recognizes that at point E, lamp A operates at its rated voltage and current, allowing calculation of the main current.

title: Circuit Analysis at Point F
description: Important: Correctly analyzes the parallel branch with lamp B and the rheostat at full resistance when C is at F.

title: Closed-Circuit Equation Application
description: Important: Applies E = U_terminal + I_total * (R_internal + other series resistances) for both switch positions.

title: Current Division Recognition
description: Optional: Explicitly states that at point F, the total current splits between the rheostat and lamp B branches.

title: Sign or Unit Error
description: Pitfall: Makes sign errors in Kirchhoff's laws or omits units in final answers.

title: Rheostat Current Confusion
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly calculates the current through the 180 Ω rheostat at point F (should be 9V/180Ω = 0.05 A).
